description: A reusable Django component library that provides production-ready UI building blocks as template tags with typed configuration dataclasses, styled with Tailwind CSS and enhanced with HTMX. Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA) is a design target.
rules: Use Insight UI components through their Django template tags and typed configuration dataclasses.
Treat WCAG 2.2 AA as a design target; assess conformance on complete pages and processes in the consuming application.
Prefer HTMX for interactivity; do not introduce a JavaScript UI framework as a requirement.
